description: This file defines an abstract class DataFrameWriterV2 and related traits for writing DataFrames to external storage in Spark using the v2 API. It includes methods for configuring write options, creating, replacing, or appending data to tables, and managing table properties.

classes.name: DataFrameWriterV2
classes.description: Abstract class providing an interface for writing DataFrames to external storage with configuration options, table creation, replacement, and appending capabilities.

methods.name: using
methods.description: Specify the data source provider for writing.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Set a write option with key and value, supporting different data types.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Set multiple write options from Scala or Java maps.

methods.name: tableProperty
methods.description: Set a property for the output table.

methods.name: partitionedBy
methods.description: Partition the output table by specified columns.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Cluster the output data by specified columns.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Append data to an existing table.

methods.name: overwrite
methods.description: Overwrite data in the table matching a filter condition.

methods.name: overwritePartitions
methods.description: Overwrite all partitions with data from the DataFrame.
